_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B2. (1) Block B, the second Qwen pair: ruadapt_qwen2.5_7B_ext_u48_instruct on probe and h1b_rest, the same prompts on which Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct held iris 84/142 and T-lite 95/142 (B1: the T-lite pair retains, McNemar p = 0.16 after the AMENDMENT_7 rules; reports/RESULTS_CANON.md §6). (2) Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on exposure_2, the first multilingual Qwen control on the high-exposure files: the strong form of H2e now rests on the OKVED 2 feature cell alone, where the YandexGPT pair named 32 and 28 of 250 codes and Mistral-Nemo did not, and Qwen decides whether it survives a second control. Planning figures from src/price_plan.py, which prices every answer to its budget x 1.15 and is validated on 34 runs (actual/plan 0.71-0.94; B1's five runs 0.71-0.77): Qwen exposure_2 5.7 h, ruadapt probe 1.2 h, ruadapt h1b_rest 3.4 h. The longer card is Qwen's, 5.7 h; the other card is 4.6 h. Qwen's context slope is borrowed from the measured 8B family, because B1's canon prompts were too short to fit it; exposure_2's prompts are 227-1163 tokens, and at three times the borrowed slope the plan is 7.5 h, still inside the session rule.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load; the canon is fetched and hash-checked from its registered sources
disk: two checkpoints at once, 30.7 GB at the peak (Qwen2.5-7B 15.2 + ruadapt-Qwen 15.5, neither with custom code); each model's last run frees its weights when written

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: feature completion on the four classifiers and header and row on the rest of exposure_2, against the baselines fixed before the Nemo run; 5.7 h; the multilingual control for the strong form of H2e. iris anchors the plan (84/142 in O1). Its only run in this session

row completion on the canon; 1.2 h; the second H1b contrast with Qwen's O1 probe on identical prompts. Its tokenizer extends Qwen's vocabulary, so the load report must show the round-trip passed and appends_eos = false
header, first token and feature, the same cells as Qwen and T-lite in B1; 3.4 h; queued on the card ruadapt's probe frees, the same weights. Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
